p.title: v59.97 a saved conversation turn without an answer no longer breaks saving
p.symptom: One stored turn without a string answer made every later save throw inside the end-of-answer handler (no more saved turns, no follow-up chips, the run held until its timeout).
p.root_cause: loadSessions kept turns as stored and turnChars read t.q.length + t.a.length, so a missing field threw during pruning.
p.fix: loadSessions (src/ai/session/chat-sessions.js) normalises each kept turn (non-objects dropped; q, a, ctx coerced to strings; at kept) and turnChars coerces its fields. A stored value that does not parse still reads as empty and the next save starts over: refusing to write would leave the reader unable to save with nothing to delete.
p.violated_rule: A bad stored record must not stop the answer flow.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check: a stored turn { q, at } without a saves the next turn with a: ''; a truncated JSON store reads as empty and the next answer is saved.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs passes; the bad-turn check fails on the old module.

changelog: **Saved AI conversations survive a bad turn ({P}):** a stored turn without an answer no longer stops later saves.
note: v59.97: chat sessions tolerate a bad stored turn
